annotation.interpretation_a: The sender must continue processing frames received *immediately* before the RST_STREAM, even if those frames are incomplete or partially processed.
annotation.interpretation_b: The sender must process frames received before the RST_STREAM, but may discard any frames received very close to the RST_STREAM if they are likely to be incomplete or corrupted due to the stream reset.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'prior to the arrival' is vague. It doesn't specify a time window or condition for determining if a frame was sent before the RST_STREAM. This allows for different interpretations of how long the endpoint should continue receiving and processing frames after sending the RST_STREAM.
annotation.missing_information: The time window between the last valid frame and the RST_STREAM is not defined. This missing constraint affects how the endpoint determines whether a frame was 'sent by the peer prior to the arrival of the RST_STREAM'.
